translations.answer: In the 21-DoF humanoid and MoCap environment of the paper, maintaining the interface unchanged and switching rewards based on step pattern, precise stroke, and task refinement allows training of a unified whole-body striking strategy; the EKF target-known version achieved 42 successful returns in 46 machine-fed serves, significantly higher than the 33 returns in the five-frame prediction-free version, thus proving that the prediction-free scheme cannot be equated to performance or directly applied to human-robot co-domain.
translations.applicability.assumptions.0: A protected MoCap court and reliable shuttle tracking are available.
translations.applicability.assumptions.1: The target lies in the reported interception envelope and the robot uses the reported 21-DoF interface.
translations.applicability.controllers.1: EKF target-known or five-frame prediction-free actor
translations.confidence_rationale: Matched hardware trials provide clear denominators for two perception variants and the curriculum is documented, but code is unavailable, human rallies lack denominators, and the system depends on MoCap.
translations.evidence.0.locator: Figure 2-6, Appendix Tables III-V and Figures 10-12
translations.evidence.0.note: Supports the staged policy, timing/interface, perception/control decomposition and 46-trial comparisons.
translations.evidence.0.title: Humanoid Whole-Body Badminton via Multi-Stage Reinforcement Learning
translations.evidence.1.note: Records official identity and no-public-code finding.
translations.evidence.1.title: Humanoid Whole-Body Badminton official project page
translations.safety.command_limits: Define robot-specific joint, racket-tip speed, interception-volume, shuttle-launch and energy limits; published peak speeds are observations, not targets for reuse.
translations.safety.emergency_stop: Test an independent stop and launcher interlock that halt robot and shuttle feed before any human enters the court.
translations.safety.protective_controls: Use an empty fenced or netted court, eye/face protection, anchored launcher, fall protection where compatible, and a safety operator outside the racket envelope.
translations.safety.robot_specific_warning: Evidence applies only to the reported 1.28 m 21-DoF platform, racket, MoCap frame and control stack.
translations.safety.staged_deployment: Progress through simulation, no-shuttle virtual targets, low-speed soft projectiles, bounded machine-fed shuttles, then separately reviewed human interaction.
